# India Smart Tools
> Simple tools for everyday India.

## About
India Smart Tools is an Indian all-in-one online utility platform providing fast, free, and privacy-first digital tools. Built specifically for students, job applicants, creators, small business owners, and everyday households across India.

- **Primary URL**: https://www.smartlytools.cyou
- **Platform Type**: Client-side Web Application (Privacy-first, zero cloud retention of user documents)
- **Target Audience**: Indian students, job seekers, creators, small business owners, professionals

## Main Categories & Available Tools

### 1. Everyday Tools (/tools/everyday)
- **QR Code Generator** (/tools/qr-generator): Creates customizable QR codes with logo support for UPI payments, Wi-Fi credentials, and URLs.
- **Password Generator** (/tools/password-generator): Cryptographically secure password and passphrase generator using Web Crypto API.
- **Unit Converter** (/tools/unit-converter): Standard metric conversions plus traditional Indian land units (Bigha, Guntha, Gaj, Ground, Marla).
- **Date Difference** (/tools/date-difference): Calculates calendar day and working business day duration between dates.
- **BMI Calculator** (/tools/bmi-calculator): Body Mass Index calculated with WHO and Asian-Indian adjusted health cutoffs.
- **Private Calling** (/tools/private-calling): Masked, privacy-first calling system under development using authorized telecom infrastructure.

### 2. Document Tools (/tools/documents)
- **JPG to PDF** (/tools/jpg-to-pdf): In-browser photo to PDF document compiler with direct WhatsApp and social sharing.
- **PDF to JPG** (/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Extracts PDF pages as individual high-resolution JPG images.
- **PDF Compressor** (/tools/pdf-compressor): Shrinks PDF file sizes to under 100 KB, 200 KB, or 500 KB for portal limits.
- **Image Compressor** (/tools/image-compressor): Reduces photo and signature file sizes to under 20 KB or 50 KB for UPSC/SSC portals.
- **Image Resizer** (/tools/image-resizer): Resizes images to exact pixel dimensions (350x450, 200x230) and passport standards.

### 3. Finance Tools (/tools/finance)
- **EMI Calculator** (/tools/emi-calculator): Standard reducing balance monthly installment solver with principal vs interest schedule.
- **SIP Calculator** (/tools/sip-calculator): Mutual fund wealth growth projector with compounding and annual step-up increments.
- **GST Calculator** (/tools/gst-calculator): Inclusive/exclusive tax calculator across Indian slabs (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) with CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown.
- **Salary Calculator** (/tools/salary-calculator): Cost to Company (CTC) to monthly take-home salary converter comparing old vs new tax regimes.
- **FD Calculator** (/tools/fd-calculator): Bank and post office fixed deposit maturity interest calculator with quarterly compounding.

### 4. Student Tools (/tools/student)
- **Percentage Calculator** (/tools/percentage-calculator): Board exam marks percentages, aggregate subject calculator, and target score solver.
- **CGPA Calculator** (/tools/cgpa-calculator): Converts university CGPA/SGPA to percentage using CBSE (9.5x), VTU, AKTU, and university formulas.
- **Age Calculator** (/tools/age-calculator): Chronological age counter in years, months, and days for government recruitment cutoff dates.
- **Study Timer** (/tools/study-timer): Distraction-free Pomodoro (25/5) and custom interval study timer.
- **Word Counter** (/tools/word-counter): Character, word, sentence, and paragraph counter with reading time and SOP length checks.
